title: Beast Whisperer
dek: Tame approved beasts for personal use or other characters.
body:
← Crafting & Skill Experience

The beast whisperer fills a unique role in Fenumion, taking on the challenge of attempting to bring to heel its many wild inhabitants, allowing for them to ride a much wider variety of mounts, and eventually, domesticate beasts so well they may serve as mounts for others.

The Beast Whisperer Progression Table

Beast Whisperer · table 1
Skill LevelSkill Exp. RequiredAbilities
Apprentice1,000May tame a pet of CR equal to 1/8 of PC level on a successful check. Available pets will be on a pre-approved list.
+2 to all Taming Rolls
Journeyman4,000May tame a pet of CR equal to 1/4 of PC level on a successful check. Available pets will be on a pre-approved list.
+4 to all Taming Rolls
Expert10,000May tame a pet of CR 1/3 of PC level on a successful check. Available pets will be on a pre-approved list
May tame a pet of CR 1/4 of the whisperer PC level on a successful check for another player character. Available pets will be on a pre-approved list.
+6 to all Taming Rolls
Master20,000May tame a pet of CR 1/2 of PC level on a successful check. Available pets will be on a pre-approved list.
May tame a pet of CR 1/3 of whisperer PC level on a successful check for another player character. Available pets will be on a pre-approved list.
+8 to all Taming Rolls

How it Works

To tame a wild creature, the beast whisperer rolls a d20 and adds their skill level modifier. Another beast whisperer of the same level or higher may use the Help action to give advantage on that roll. This roll cannot be modified in any way except as outlined in this skill description. Successfully taming a creature requires meeting a DC based on the creature’s challenge rating and may require several successful attempts, as defined below:

Beast Whisperer · table 2
CR of Wild CreatureDC Required to TameNumber of Successful Tames
CR 0 - CR 2DC 5One success needed
CR 3 - CR 4DC 10Two successes needed
CR 5 - CR 6DC 15Three successes needed
CR 7 - CR 8DC 20Four successes needed
CR 9 - CR 10DC 25Five successes needed

A beast whisperer may attempt to tame a creature multiple times per day. However, if the DC to tame the creature is failed by 5 or more, the beast whisperer must wait 24 hours until attempting to tame any creature again. If a natural 1 is rolled while attempting to tame a pet, it runs away at the first chance and disappears.

A tamed beast does not count against the server’s summon limits, though a whisperer may only have a number of personally tamed beasts equal to ¼ of their character level. Characters without the Beast Whisperer trade skill may only have one beast trained for them at a time. If a new beast is trained for them, the previous beast escapes back to the wild. Also keep in mind the server’s restrictions on gifts to PCs which give them access to things they otherwise should not have.
